method: Rank mean of validation and test all-attempt accuracy; require validation coverage and >=8 test attempts; ties: test accuracy, test support, word descending.
limitations: Previously inspected cached ASL Citizen data, not fresh or live testing.
Selection uses these scores; selected-subset scores are selection-biased.
81-class model remains unchanged; no 50-class model was fitted.
Cached landmark replay includes quality rejection but does not rerun video decoding or live tracking.
No independent cross-source evidence for every word.
